newsitem.title: USA: Aris Industries says buys Davco assets.
newsitem.headline: Aris Industries says buys Davco assets.

text.p: Aris Industries Inc said Monday it has acquired the assets of Davco Industries Inc, a maker of men's and boy's clothes under the "Perry Ellis," "Perry Ellis America," and "Jeffrey Banks" labels.
Aris bought these assets from Davco's principals, Steven Arnold and Christopher Healy.

The purchase price consists of three million shares of Aris common stock, constituting about 20 percent of Aris' outstanding shares, plus a contingent cash amount based on the performance of the acquired business in 1997.
The new business will be operated by ECI Sportswear Inc, a subsidiary of Aris' Europe Craft Imports Inc subsidiary.
Arnold will be president and Healy will be chief operating officer of ECI Sportswear Inc.
They will report to Charles Ramat, chairman and CEO of Aris and ECI.
